notes: The batch-B row is the EMBLEM card itself (is_emblem, empty printed text); this pack witnesses the emblem's reach through its generator: the compiled -7 (idx 2, loyalty seeded to 7) exiles Liliana to the graveyard and the emblem it mints grants a static HASTE to the Grave Beast the -7's earlier ability had reanimated - the emblem has no battlefield handle, so its presence is asserted through the granted keyword, and the 2/2 beater then swings the same turn for exactly 2 damage (20->18).
